responsibility: Defines the board-level subtarget defaults for Xilinx embedded PowerPC systems. It overrides the preprocessor, library, startup, and linker default specs to force Xilinx FPU awareness, define HAVE_XFPU feature macros from -mfpu= selections, choose Xilinx runtime libraries and startup objects, and use the Xilinx linker script, making it the integration header for GCC-generated code with the Xilinx embedded runtime environment.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem .opt file, this header applies the Xilinx subtarget policy by redefining GCC specs for preprocessing, libraries, startup files, and linking; it consumes option state rather than declaring the options themselves.
